retained_baseline_artifact.hash_scope: Complete private three-feature retained-baseline GeoJSON; target selected by exact awId

review.method: All retained parts plotted together and visually compared with BOM Figures11.1/11.22, DBCA locality/Marsh maps, and Department of Water Millstream/lower-corridor maps. No map georeferencing or numerical spatial-match claim.
observations: The retained route begins in the southeastern interior, turns northwest into the long valley corridor and reaches the coastal plain southwest of Karratha.
Its overall direction and distinctive northwest lower course are consistent with the official Fortescue mapping, independently of the initial name lead.
The easternmost headwater and individual marsh-channel/connector names remain unresolved; regional consistency does not justify every line part inheriting the representative name.

limits: Representative-system identity is a regional naming inference, not a continuous-flow or per-reach claim.
The retained terminal is a rendering endpoint, not a surveyed present mouth.
Original HydroRIVERS coordinates are unavailable; equality between original and retained coordinates was not tested.
Current live deployment was not checked.
